units.source_text: 透過背後的高窗，看得見綴滿晚霞的天空，一群海鷗排成「女」字形，向遠方飛去。

en.t: Through the high window behind him, he could see the sky streaked with sunset clouds, and a flock of seagulls flew off into the distance in the shape of the character 女.

units.source_text: [1]聖德太子（574-622），日本飛鳥時代的皇族，政治家。

en.t: [1] Prince Shotoku (574-622) was a member of the Japanese imperial family and a statesman of the Asuka period.
He was the second son of Emperor Yomei.
